newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan awards one diesel sale cargo, more seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan awards one diesel sale cargo, more seen.

text.p: State-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has sold by tender one 225,000-250,000 barrel cargo of 0.3 percent sulphur gas oil and is expected to award at least one more cargo on Wednesday, a CPC source said on Tuesday.
The cargo for lifting January 26-February 15 was awarded at around $29.50 per barrel on a free-on-board Kaohsiung basis, the source said.
The tender attracted a total of 10 bids.
In its last tender, CPC sold three cargoes for December 11-30 lifting at $29.92 per barrel, fob.
